scope: Official GPX availability and 2027 course-version review for top-level events 61–70
safetyRules: Old GPX files remain valid until an official replacement is downloaded, parsed and validated.
No existing GPX files were deleted, overwritten or replaced.
A Map + GPX panel or direct link is not a successful binary download or a validated track.
Do not treat a previous edition's GPX as a 2027 course.

routes.name: Family Trail
routes.gpxStatus: two official 2027 GPX links previously recorded

checks.detail: Correction: current official homepage says eight competitions, with Family Trail having two distance options; it lists 108km/6677hm Extreme 100, 76.6km/5080hm Ultra, 53.2km/3061hm Endurance, 34.6km/2029hm Ultimate, 16.2km/1113hm Panorama, 8.9km/436hm Easy, 5.3km/536hm Vertical, and Family 3.1km/5.4km. Prior checkpoint said nine current competitions and used different route names/figures. Three previously recorded 2027 direct GPX URLs were opened: two inaccessible, one rejected as unsupported application/gpx+xml. No file bytes retrieved.
Official FAQ explicitly says GPX is released only a few days before the event because the route crosses private land. Official event site confirms 6–10 July 2027 and GT20K 17km/650m+.

Official UTMB race pages expose Map + GPX sections. X-Traversée has a 2027 route modification near Grand St-Bernard. Export each distance separately from the official map; no binary download was completed.

Previous official event record was 12 July 2026, now past. Official route-map pages have GPX/KML download controls but no next edition/date confirmed in the checkpoint. Do not mark 2026 tracks as 2027.

Organizer's current page gives 22–25 July 2027 and updated distances. Registration start has been moved to 1 December 2026 at 00:00 due to administrative items and route revisions. Previous app 100K entry is not in current official program and must not be treated as confirmed.
Official site confirms four routes and dates 16–17 July 2027. Existing app has four official GPX links; each needs actual import/parser validation.
Organizer pages offer course downloads for 64km Ultra, T30 and T13. No file downloaded or parsed in this pass.
Official 2027 route pages exist for Fassa Trail, SkyRace and V-Rodella. V-Rodella page says GPX will be published later. Keep any old tracks historical.

Current E101 page confirms 101km/6700m+ and 17 July 2027; E51 page confirms 2027 start and a Download GPX control. Current pages now expose downloadable GPX controls; do not rely on prior 2026 file links. Need retrieve actual current hrefs, confirm 2027 version and parse both files.

UTMB event calendar confirms 23–25 July 2027. Five race formats have official direct GPX links in the previous checkpoint; Rumble Rock GPX was still marked coming soon and RUNC Challenge file had no 2027 confirmation. No direct binary retrieval or parsing in this pass.

criticalFindings: Obertauern 2027 official homepage corrects event inventory: eight competitions with Family Trail split into 3.1km and 5.4km, not nine adult competitions.
Obertauern updated official distances/elevation: Extreme 100 108km/6677m; Ultra 76.6/5080; Endurance 53.2/3061; Ultimate 34.6/2029; Panorama 16.2/1113; Easy 8.9/436; Vertical 5.3/536.
Restonica official FAQ confirms GPX release only a few days before the event due to private land.
Glacier Trailrun 2027 updated route programme no longer lists the old 100K; six race categories with revised distances, registration 1 December 2026.
Eiger 2027 official pages now display GPX downloads, replacing earlier 2026-stale status; actual file version still to validate.
